en: It's fine. I know he ain't perfect.
We work as hostesses at Rose Hip, that club over there. Himura-san used to be one of our regulars.
He really took a liking to one of our girls: Kaguya.
(So what he said in prison was true...)
But, his enthusiasm was kind of over the top, you know? Honestly, he was starting to become a problem.
Even Kaguya was getting fed up. She complained to our manager constantly.
Geez...
At first we put up with it because he was such a big spender, but gradually it got worse and worse.
And his ego! Ugh, he was such a blowhard.
Hey, this is his friend! Sorry about her.
It finally got to the point where our manager had to have a talk with Himura-san.
And we haven't seen him since! In fact, it was a long time later that we heard he got arrested.
Yep... All that money he was dropping must have been from the bribes.
Huh... I had no idea.
I'm sorry. Maybe we shouldn't have told you.
No, no, don't worry about it. 'Preciate your candor. Sorry to keep ya.
No apology necessary.
(Himura was so cheerful tellin' those stories. Ya never know, I guess.)
The club's been so quiet lately. Not a single instance of anybody pulling a Himura.
Yeah... Too bad that gives Kaguya enough time to be so annoying.
Hey, she's doing better than you. You need to up your game if you want regulars.
(...Did she say Himura?)
I realize there could be an escaped convict on the loose, but do we really need all these police? They make the shoppers nervous.
Yeah... And it's not like you can trust the police, anyway.
That's true. What was the one guy's name? Oh yeah, Himura! A homicide detective on the take⑬can you believe that?
(Himura sure made a name for himself here. Wonder what else these folks know...)
Certainly! How may I serve you, good sir?
Calm down, bud, I'm no customer. I just wanna know 'bout that detective Himura.
You never heard? A while ago, there was an arms trafficking deal set up by a foreign gang. I think it was the mafia!
Himura knew about the deal, but he ignored it in return for mafia hush money.
(Geez, that's the opposite of what he said.)
So obviously, the police took a lot of criticism for that. Now they're desperate to fix their image.
That's right. They're especially eager to nab anyone in the mafia, because word on the street is they're running guns again.
Oh, yeah? Well... thanks.
No problem. Anytime.
Yeah, he can be a show-off. It's the best, and the worst thing about 'im. He sure had me fooled. But hey, it was fun while it lasted.
(Is he serious?)
Look, I know he did wrong, and he oughta pay for it.
But yer talkin' about the guy who saved my life. Just wanted ya to know that.
What are you waiting for!? That's Saejima! The escaped prisoner!
Yer right. But sorry, I ain't ready to get caught yet!
Damn it! Wait!
Saved his life, huh?
I guess you're not rotten to the core after all, Himura... Hope I see you again one of these days. We could go for drinks, like old times.
Argh... I guess the deal already went down. Dammit.
Shit... What a mess.
(Shit!)
Huh!? Who're you!? Stay away!
Wait, that's...
Tell ya the truth, I ain't even sure why I'm stickin' my neck out like this.
But I owe Himura, and it's 'bout time I pay that debt!
You sure the tip about that arms deal is good?
Yeah. We'll round them all up this time. That'll wash the stink of Himura off us, once and for all.
I still can't believe he was dirty.
You didn't see it coming? You and him were partners for ages.
He was a blowhard. Always trying to impress.
Yeah, he was always flashing cash for you rookies. Probably the same mindset that made him go off the rails.
You think so?
That's my theory. Anyway, screw him. Where's this deal supposed to go down?
I already told you... The plaza in Ramen Village.
Let's head out, then!
(That's the place Himura was talkin' about. Shouldn't get too close with the cops n' all, but I gotta see this with my own eyes.)
Phew! That was a lot of fun!

Thank you so much for doing that for me, Haruka-chan. I was
watching you on the monitor backstage. You were great!
Phew. I'm sorry. I don't know if I helped all that much...

Don't be silly. I really appreciate your doing that for me!
And thanks to you, my fans had a great time.
That's nice of you to say. How are you feeling?

I took some medicine so I feel a little bit better, but my
head still feels all foggy.
You really should get some rest.

I'm sorry you didn't get to see me perform like you wanted.
You came all this way...
Oh, about that. I actually have a small favor to ask of you.
You do? What is it?
Well, I was hoping to get your autograph.
Really? What would you want with that?

My manager is a big fan of yours. He's in the hospital right
now, recovering from an injury.

I thought if I got your autograph for him, it might help
cheer him up.

Oh, why didn't you say so? I'd be happy to give you my
autograph!
Just wait right here. Oh, what's your manager's name?
It's Hiroshi Horie-san.
Hiroshi Horie-san. Got it!
Oh, thank you, Airi!
Don't mention it. Tell Horie-san I said hello.
Wait a minute... Hiroshi Horie-san?
Is he a guy around thirty? Spiky hair and glasses?
Yes, that's him! Do you know him?

I do! So he's your manager, huh? And you say he's in the
hospital? Oh, I hope he's gonna be all right.

Yes. He'll have to stay there a while, but thankfully, they
say he'll be okay.

I'm really glad to hear that. He's been coming to see me
perform for as long as I can remember.

That's what I hear! I didn't even know he was a fan of
yours until recently.

He even sends me these long, incredibly thoughtful fan
letters.

He wrote, "Life in the entertainment industry can be hard at
times, but please never let yourself get discouraged!"

His words were so warm and supportive! I can't tell you how
many times they've cheered me up.

With fans like that, I can see why you were so determined to
go on today.

Yes. After all the love and support they've given me, I just
didn't wanna let them down.

If you hadn't stopped me, who knows what I would've done to
my health? That wouldn't have made anybody happy, least of all my fans.
Well, I certainly admire your devotion to them.

But a real pro takes care of herself, right? You know what?
When I get better, I wanna give you a proper thank you for helping me today.
Oh, you don't have to do that! The autograph is more than enough.

Just get better soon, and show your fans the healthy Airi-san
they all want to see.
All right, I will! I promise.
Airi-chan, you're in no shape to be doing this!
No! I have to...!
You're just gonna get worse!
Excuse me, but... is everything all right?
Huh? I'm sorry, but this area is off-limits⑬

Wait a minute! You're Haruka Sawamura-chan from Dyna Chair,
aren't you?
Yes, that's right. It's nice to meet you.
What brings you here?
Well, I came to see Airi-chan perform.
You came to see me?

See, that's the thing. She has the flu, and it's really bad.
I've been telling her she's in no shape to perform right
now, but she won't listen.
What? You have the flu?
I'm fine! I'm perfectly well enough to go on.
Yeah, right. What about your fever!?
Err...
It does sound like it might be a good idea to take the day off.

(Now what do I do? This is no time to be asking poor Airi
for her autograph.)
No. I'm doing it!
Airi-chan, why are you being so stubborn about this?
*pant* *pant* I can't let my fans down!

They've always been so supportive of me. If I act like a
sniveling baby and bow out now, I'd feel like I was
betraying them.

Their support gives me the strength to do anything. After
all the love they've given me, I just wanna give them a great performance!
Airi-san...
*cough* *cough*
Airi-chan!

I understand how you feel, but if you overdo it and make
yourself sicker, you'll only make your fans feel bad.

The best thing you could do for your fans is take the day
off and get better as soon as possible. That's the Airi they
want to see.
But what about the performance? Everybody's waiting for me.

Don't you worry about that! I'll find somebody to go on in
your place.

But how? It's about to start. Do you expect someone to just
fall out of the sky?
It's quite the dilemma, isn't it?
Wait a minute!
I think someone did just fall out of the sky!
Haruka-chan, will you do it? Will you go on in my place!?
Me? But I⑬

I saw you on TV, so I know how good you are! My fans would
be thrilled if somebody as great as you went on for me.

I know we just met, and I have no right to be asking you for
a favor like this, but do you think you could it? Please, Haruka-chan!

All right, I'll do it. I'm no replacement for you, but I'll
do what I can.
You will!? Oh, thank you!

Great! That's perfect! Get ready, then. The show's just
about start!
Have you decided what you'll ask Santa for Christmas yet?
Yeah, a smartphone!
Well, aren't you a clever little thing? But smartphones are for grown-ups, dear.
Aww! But I wanna get a smartphone, Mom! If you love me, you'll get one!
Hmm, I sure don't mind, but I don't think Santa's little elves can make those.
Dang it...
(I guess the holidays are on the horizon.)
(It's already been a year since my last Christmas at Morning Glory...)
(I wish I could do something for the kids this time of year at least.)
(The guys at Nagasu Taxi might have some ideas.)
(Maybe I'll ask Wada-san about it.)
(Well, I sent money for all eight kids. Probably just to feel better about myself, but still...)
Hey, Suzuki-san!
Oh, Wada-san. Didn't see you there.
Yep, just passing by. You sending money again?
Yeah... I may be causing more harm than good, though. Who knows?
Hard to say. I don't know much about your background.
But what I do know, Suzuki-san, is you're a dedicated man. I can't imagine anyone complaining about that.
...I hope you're right.
Of course I am! Now then... We drink!
We're drinking?

Oh yes! This is one of the rare moments in our adult lives
where we can take a step back and actually appreciate the
responsibilities we have. Can't waste an opportunity like that!
Heh... You may just have a point there. Okay, lead the way.
Mmm, that was so yummy!
Well, I guess we better get going.
That was a lot of fun, Haruka-chan. Thanks for coming along!

We don't get to see ya much in school, so I'm glad we got to
hang out. You're all right by us!

Here, I want you to have this. Take it as a sign of our new
friendship!
Cool, thank you!
All right, see ya at school!
Yes. See you later!

Sorry we gotta rush off. We're meeting up with our
boyfriends.
Oh, that's all right, I understand. Bye, now!
Bye-bye!

(Whew! I guess I managed to keep up with the conversation,
but I feel completely exhausted now.)

(It's not that easy fitting in with other high school
girls.)
Well, we'll be seeing ya, Haruka-chan.

I guess idols don't have all that much in common with us
regular high school girls.
Oh, I wouldn't say that...
Anyway, we better go.
Of course. I understand.
Bye-bye.

(I couldn't keep up with the conversation at all! I guess I
just don't fit in with other high school girls.)

Oh, hi, Haruka-chan! Did ya decide to come have okonomiyaki
with us after all? It's that restaurant right over there.

Yeah, let's go! And then we can ask ya all about show
business! Whaddya say?

(Should I go? I don't have that many chances to make friends
at school. This might be a good opportunity.)
I'm sorry. I'm afraid I can't right now. Maybe next time?
Oh, you can't? That's too bad.

All right. If you're sure you wouldn't mind, I'd love to
come along!
Oh, don't be so polite! We're classmates, aren't we?

Yeah, let's go! I've never gone out to eat with somebody
famous before!
Haruka-chan!
Oh! Yui-chan.

Those two girls are in your class, aren't they? Did you guys
go eat okonomiyaki together?

I'm jealous! I wish I could've gone and spent some time with
you.
...Everything all right, Haruka-chan?

Well, it's just those girls were talking about all kinds of
stuff, but I just couldn't seem to keep up with the conversation.

Maybe it's because I don't have a regular high school girl
life, what with my job and everything? I guess I just don't
really fit in.

Aw, you don't have to worry about that, Haruka. Not
everybody is like those two girls, you know.

Different people like to talk about different things. I bet
you aren't the only one who feels like she can't keep up
with certain subjects.
